Collision |pvp_ranged_damage = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]]5 |pvp_ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0.25 |pvp_ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]20 |pvp_speed = 4 |pvp_hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |pvp_lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} (Collision only) |pvp_flying = No }} ==Description== The '''Tommy Goon 1''', also referred to as '''Tommy Crook''', is a unit that can be spawned from the [[Crook Boss]] at Level 3. On the wiki it is referred to as ''Tommy Goon 1'' to differentiate it from the [[Tommy Goon 2]], as they share an identical display name in-game. Like most other units, it starts from one of the entrances of the map and moves towards the exit. Whenever there is an enemy in its range, it will stop moving to attack it and all other detectable enemies in its range. It will continue walking if there are no enemies in its range for a few seconds. The '''Tommy Goon 1''' can detect hidden enemies, though it cannot detect flying enemies. It has a 32.5 second spawnrate. The '''Tommy Goon 1''' is replaced by the [[Tommy Goon 2]] when the [[Crook Boss]] is upgraded to Level 4. There is a limit of three '''Tommy Goon 1s''' and [[Tommy Goon 2]]s per [[Crook Boss]]. ==Appearance== The '''Tommy Goon 1''' has tan skin. It wears a white shirt red tie, brown pants and gloves, black shoes, maroon tie, black belt with a golden buckle, black overalls and a brown dapper hat. [[Tower Defense Simulator Toys|Merch Shop]]Obtained by purchasing the [[Narrator Plush]]. |[[Beach Crate]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''Tommy Goon 1''' can be quite useful against enemies that appear in the mid-game, as it has decent DPS, spawns quickly and has hidden detection, thought it should not be solely relied on. *The '''Tommy Goon 1''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, like the [[Reaver]] or [[Hazmat]]. **Its gun damage is still reduced by defense. *On maps with multiple paths, only one '''Tommy Goon 1''' spawns per [[Crook Boss]], it will go down a random path. *The '''Tommy Goon 1''' is unaffected by buffs and debuffs. *The '''Tommy Goon 1''' will struggle against enemies with abilities that deal damage to units because of its low health. **For example, the [[Warden (Modern Enemy)|Warden]] will quickly kill the '''Tommy Goon 1''' if its caught in its laser. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''10 February 2024''' -
